scope: sched_walt (phone CPU governor "walt") running on android18-7.3 in QEMU with a private cpufreq/energy-model fixture
core_changes: android_pick_task(rq, rf) export (6.12 exported pick_task(rq)); __balance_callbacks export
android_vh_mutex_add_waiter_pos: 7.3 waiter ring -> vendor chooses insert position, native code inserts

details: walt governor selected on both policies
big cluster 384000 -> 3436800 kHz under load and back to 556800-2476800 kHz idle
12 mixed tasks + 3x CPU3 offline/online + 3x schedutil<->walt round trips

bugs_found_and_fixed: Booting without android_arch_task_struct_size let WALT write past task_struct and underflow a neighbour task refcount (delayed_put_task_struct WARN); module now refuses to load in that case
7.3 always-on rq clock assertions: WALT detach/attach lacked update_rq_clock and MOTO code read rq_clock before taking the lock
walt_init blocked waiting for a cycle counter in QEMU (phone uses qcom,gclk MMIO)
open_risk: A misconfigured fixture (no CPUFREQ_HAVE_GOVERNOR_PER_POLICY) made waltgov_init fail mid-way and was followed by CFS h_curr corruption/Oops; the phone driver sets the flag, but the waltgov_init error path must be audited before device use
not_verified: qcom,gclk counters, SCMI cpufreq, perf HAL, thermal_pause/moto_sched/core_ctl consumers on hardware
